title: Treasure chest with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Chest body -->
  <rect x='15' y='45' width='70' height='40' rx='5' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- Chest body lighter front panel -->
  <rect x='20' y='50' width='60' height='30' rx='3' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- Chest lid -->
  <path d='M12 45 Q12 20 50 20 Q88 20 88 45 Z' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <!-- Lid top highlight -->
  <path d='M20 43 Q20 26 50 26 Q80 26 80 43 Z' fill='#E08040'/>
  <!-- Lid rim -->
  <rect x='12' y='42' width='76' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Lock plate -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='16' height='16' rx='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Keyhole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='44' width='3' height='6' fill='#8B6914'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on chest -->
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='59' r='1.5' fill='#90EE90'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='59' r='1.5' fill='#90EE90'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='66' r='4' fill='#FF6B6B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='66' r='4' fill='#FF6B6B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 68 Q50 80 62 68' stroke='#2E8B57' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Band details -->
  <rect x='15' y='55' width='6' height='30' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='79' y='55' width='6' height='30' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x='20' y='85' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='68' y='85' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d='M8 30 L10 34 L14 34 L11 37 L12 41 L8 38 L4 41 L5 37 L2 34 L6 34 Z' fill='#FFD700' transform='scale(0.6) translate(10,10)'/>
  <path d='M85 12 L87 16 L91 16 L88 19 L89 23 L85 20 L81 23 L82 19 L79 16 L83 16 Z' fill='#FFD700' transform='scale(0.7) translate(30,5)'/>
</svg>
